lvl1_rule.claim: Table pairs (S glyph -> P glyph). Bottom: sky=input row (rotated table glyphs), pink=answer row. LEFT/RIGHT move cursor over 5 slots; UP/DOWN cycle ~7 options/slot. Set each pink slot to partner glyph (pose = same transform).
